title: Prepare Saved View Rollout Target Eligibility Contract

eligibility_decision.reason: The target is an internal rollout target tooling surface. It describes the locked rollout target and exports rollout planning metadata rather than representing a business report with user-owned report filters.
eligibility_decision.recommended_next_phase: Exclude saved-view-rollout-target from the rollout selector before selecting the next business report target.

proposed_exclusion.exclusion_rule: ReportSavedViewRolloutSelector should ignore internal saved-view tooling candidates such as saved-view-rollout-target.
proposed_exclusion.expected_result_after_exclusion: saved-view-rollout-target should no longer be the next rollout target.

guardrails: Do not add saved view controls to internal rollout tooling pages.
Do not register saved-view-rollout-target in ReportSavedViewRegistry.
Do not add saved view store routes for rollout tooling pages.
Do not modify shared saved view partials.
Implement exclusion in selector/prioritization before locking the next target.
